description: Get the FULL text of one section of a doc by heading — use it to expand a truncated search_docs / search_all result. `file` accepts the source label exactly as search results print it ('skill/SKILL.md', 'skill/xy', 'extended/charts/xy-chart/cursor', 'reference/xycursor') as well as a bare skill file name ('SKILL', 'xy', 'map').

file.description: Doc identifier: a skill file ('SKILL', 'xy', 'pie', 'map') or a source label from search results ('skill/SKILL.md', 'extended/concepts/events', 'reference/xycursor'). '.md' and 'skill/' / 'extended/' prefixes are optional.

heading.description: Section heading to retrieve (case-insensitive substring), e.g. 'Core setup pattern', 'Axis types', 'Common pitfalls', 'Recent API changes'

name: get_section
